summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for Gate 8 covering-suite selection. Phase 1 adds an opt-in --gate8-touched input to verify-deploy.sh; Phase 2 narrows gate8_run()'s run-all.sh invocation through suite_selection_select and, in the same atomic-batch commit, forces gate8 onto GATE_DIRTY_LIST so a narrowed pass can never write a full-@extensions-corpus cache entry; Phases 3-4 add a dedicated regression suite and the docs/contract updates; Phase 5 redeploys, adds the sequencing dependencies[] edge to the call-site task, and runs the unnarrowed full gate set. Call-site wiring (orchestrate-batch-gate.sh Move 4, Mechanism A) is an explicit non-goal, outside this task's file_scope and inside a concurrent sibling's.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: opt-in --gate8-touched narrowing of Gate 8, forced cache-ineligibility, regression suite, docs, redeploy + full gate.
